title: When to Stop Penalizing Actions? Martingale GRPO for VLA Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32431v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A failed vision-language-action (VLA) rollout does not imply that every action contributed to failure. Yet in group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), a single trajectory-level advantage is assigned to all actions in a rollout. Potentially useful recovery attempts can thus be penalized alongside the errors they aim to correct. Ideal stopping conditions for failure feedback are characterized using success-probability and policy-score martingales. At these stops, the removed gradient contribution has zero conditional expectation given the retained information. Truncation therefore preserves the expectation of a reference GRPO group-gradient estimator and can reduce its covariance. One such stop occurs when the conditional probability of success is zero, motivating error and recovery cues for selecting candidate feedback boundaries. Martingale GRPO (MART-GRPO) is introduced with a vision-language model (VLM) for event-guided truncation. T

translated_title: 何时停止惩罚动作？用于VLA强化学习的鞅GRPO（Martingale GRPO）
translated_abstract: 一次失败的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）轨迹并不意味着其中每一个动作都对失败有贡献。然而在组相对策略优化（GRPO）中，单一的轨迹级优势会被分配给一次采样中的所有动作，这使得潜在有用的恢复尝试可能与其试图纠正的错误一起受到惩罚。本文利用成功概率鞅和策略得分鞅刻画了失败反馈的理想停止条件。在这些停止点上，被移除的梯度贡献在给定保留信息的条件下条件期望为零。因此，截断能够保持参考GRPO组梯度估计器的期望，并可以降低其协方差。其中一种停止条件出现在成功条件概率为零的时刻，这启发了用于选择候选反馈边界的错误与恢复线索。本文提出了结合视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行事件引导截断的鞅GRPO（MART-GRPO）。
tldr: 提出MART-GRPO，通过成功概率与策略得分鞅刻画失败反馈的理想停止条件，并借助视觉-语言模型进行事件引导截断，避免GRPO将轨迹级惩罚错误地施加到失败轨迹中有用的恢复动作上。
en_tdlr: MART-GRPO characterizes ideal stopping conditions for failure feedback via success-probability and policy-score martingales and uses a VLM for event-guided truncation, preventing GRPO's trajectory-level penalty from punishing useful recovery actions in failed VLA rollouts.
